Name: Advent Calendar (CP)
Author: DeadlyEssence01
Description:
This Advent Calendar is a quick and dirty version. For the first 24 days of winter you receive a randomized gift in the mail. Each day the item category changes. [i](and if I can find enough riddles I will make a riddle version that lets you answer a riddle to figure out the next day's theme).[/i]

I tried to make the loot pool early and late game relevant, so you can hopefully still find the gifts useful even if you're later in the game, and hopefully not too OP if you're early in the game.
[i]

[/i]I am uncertain if I will change how this calendar works. I have a few different ideas for changing it up or improving it, but for now this works. Feel free to leave your thoughts in the comments.
